locations.note: A total-conversion mod of Fallout 4 that rebuilds a post-nuclear London of 2237, fifteen boroughs from Camden to Croydon, with the Thames, the Underground and the landmarks standing in the ruins.
The Palace of Westminster and its clock tower stand over the wasteland of Westminster.
The abbey is among the Westminster landmarks the mod rebuilds.
Buckingham Palace survives into 2237 as one of the great set pieces.
Downing Street is one of the named places of the Westminster region.
The London Eye still turns over the Thames, and a settlement sits just south of it.
St Paul's anchors the City of London region.
Tower Bridge is one of the landmarks that make the capital recognisable.
The Bank of England is a region of its own, with keys to hunt down inside.
Camden and its Underground station are one of the fifteen boroughs.
